tagline.zh: 噪点渐变:SVG feTurbulence 生成灰噪点铺在渐变上,再推 contrast/brightness 变成颗粒——主作用是杀死廉价屏上的渐变色带(banding)。
tagline.en: Grainy gradients: SVG feTurbulence generates gray noise laid over the gradient, then contrast/brightness pushes it into grain — whose main job is killing gradient banding on cheap panels.

origin.zh: 社区配方,出处 CSS-Tricks《Grainy Gradients》(调研 06§四15 一手抓取);轻量变体(低 opacity 噪点层消色带)与层 opacity 0.16 取自 CodeFronts 同页实例。
origin.en: A community recipe from CSS-Tricks' 'Grainy Gradients' (research 06 §15, primary fetch); the lightweight variant (low-opacity noise layer against banding) and the 0.16 layer opacity come from CodeFronts' example on the same page.

effect.zh: feTurbulence 噪点频率,控制颗粒粗细。默认 0.65 为 CSS-Tricks 配方原文(fractalNoise + baseFrequency='0.65');CodeFronts 轻量变体用 0.9。JS 型参数:demo 改值后重写 SVG 属性并重建 data-URI。
effect.en: feTurbulence noise frequency, setting grain coarseness. Default 0.65 is the CSS-Tricks recipe verbatim (fractalNoise + baseFrequency='0.65'); CodeFronts' lightweight variant uses 0.9. JS-type param: the demo rebuilds the data-URI with the rewritten SVG attribute.

effect.zh: 湍流倍频数,越大细节越碎、渲染越贵。默认 3 为 CSS-Tricks 配方原文(numOctaves='3')。JS 型参数:demo 改值后重写 SVG 属性并重建 data-URI。
effect.en: Turbulence octave count — more octaves means finer detail and higher render cost. Default 3 is the CSS-Tricks recipe verbatim (numOctaves='3'). JS-type param: the demo rebuilds the data-URI with the rewritten SVG attribute.

effect.zh: 把灰噪点推向颗粒感的 contrast 滤镜值。默认 170% 为 CSS-Tricks 配方原文(filter: contrast(170%) brightness(1000%));原配方同时 brightness(1000%),本条目把它固定在 demo 内不再单列。
effect.en: The contrast filter value pushing gray noise into grain. Default 170% is the CSS-Tricks recipe verbatim (filter: contrast(170%) brightness(1000%)); the recipe's brightness(1000%) is fixed inside the demo rather than listed as its own param.

effect.zh: 噪点层整体不透明度。默认 0.16 取自 CodeFronts 轻量变体(内联 data-URI feTurbulence baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='2',噪点层 opacity: .16)——足以杀死色带又不显脏(调研 06§15)。
effect.en: Overall opacity of the noise layer. Default 0.16 comes from CodeFronts' lightweight variant (inline data-URI feTurbulence baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='2', noise layer opacity: .16) — enough to kill banding without looking dirty (research 06 §15).

note.zh: SVG 滤镜 feTurbulence 与 CSS filter 均为老基线能力(全主流浏览器多年支持);data-URI SVG 作 background-image 通用。本次调研未逐浏览器核验 feTurbulence 的兼容矩阵,按 MDN 惯例视为基线。
note.en: Both the feTurbulence SVG filter and CSS filter are baseline capabilities (long supported across mainstream browsers); data-URI SVG as background-image is universal. This research pass did not audit a per-browser matrix for feTurbulence; treated as baseline per MDN convention.

fallback.zh: 不支持 SVG 滤镜的环境直接退回纯渐变(少一层质感,不丢信息);contrast 滤镜缺失时噪点保持灰色平铺——仍保留消色带作用;噪点层永远 aria-hidden 装饰,可整层移除。
fallback.en: Without SVG filter support fall back to the plain gradient (loses texture, not information); without the contrast filter the noise stays flat gray — still enough to break banding; the noise layer is always an aria-hidden decoration and can be removed wholesale.

use.zh: 大面积单色渐变上的消色带层:0.16 级低透明度噪点在廉价屏上效果最明显
use.en: Anti-banding layer over large flat gradients: 0.16-class low opacity shows most on cheap panels

use.zh: 海报感/印刷感的氛围纹理——contrast 推高后成为可见颗粒风格
use.en: Poster/print-flavored ambience — high contrast turns the noise into a visible grain style

use.zh: 深色 UI 的『哑光』处理:细颗粒弱化 OLED 深底的色带与烧屏观感
use.en: Matte treatment for dark UIs: fine grain softens banding and the glossy feel of deep OLED surfaces

use.zh: 渐变 hero、按钮、卡片的背景增质,成本几乎为零(data-URI 内联)
use.en: Texturing gradient heroes, buttons and cards at near-zero cost (inline data-URI)

avoid.zh: 文字正上方的高对比噪点——contrast/brightness 极端值会吃掉色彩并干扰小字(CSS-Tricks 评论区提示)
avoid.en: High-contrast grain right under text — extreme contrast/brightness eats color and disturbs small type (noted in the CSS-Tricks comments)

avoid.zh: box-shadow 上直接套用——该技术不作用于阴影,需要另行处理(CSS-Tricks 原文)
avoid.en: Applying it to box-shadow — the technique does not reach shadows and needs separate handling (per the CSS-Tricks article)

avoid.zh: numOctaves 拉满 + 大面积铺满——渲染成本随倍频数上涨,大画布会卡
avoid.en: numOctaves maxed out over large canvases — cost climbs with octaves and large areas stutter

avoid.zh: 期待噪点改善可访问性——它是纯装饰,对比度验收仍按无噪点底色计算
avoid.en: Expecting grain to improve accessibility — it is pure decoration; contrast sign-off still uses the ungrained base

a11y.zh: 噪点是纯装饰:层上 aria-hidden、不承载任何信息;消色带作用属于视觉舒适度而非可访问性指标;其上文字对比度按未加噪点的底色核算(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3);对前庭敏感用户无动效负担(本条目默认静止)。
a11y.en: Grain is pure decoration: the layer is aria-hidden and carries no information; banding relief is visual comfort, not an accessibility metric; text contrast is computed against the ungrained base (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3); no vestibular burden since the entry is static by default.

goal.zh: 给一块大渐变加消色带噪点:内联 SVG feTurbulence(fractalNoise,stitchTiles='stitch')生成灰噪点铺满,层 opacity 0.16、filter contrast/brightness 推颗粒,渐变一端透明让噪点透出。
goal.en: Add an anti-banding grain to a large gradient: inline SVG feTurbulence (fractalNoise, stitchTiles='stitch') fills a noise layer at opacity 0.16 with a contrast/brightness filter pushing grain, the gradient ending transparent so noise shows through.

acceptance.zh: feTurbulence 用 type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'(快照值)
acceptance.en: feTurbulence uses type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch' (snapshot values)

acceptance.zh: 噪点层 opacity 0.16,filter contrast(170%) brightness(1000%),只作用噪点层不动渐变本体
acceptance.en: Noise layer at opacity 0.16 with filter contrast(170%) brightness(1000%) applied to the noise layer only, never the gradient itself

acceptance.zh: 噪点以 data-URI SVG 作 background-image 平铺,不引入外部请求
acceptance.en: Noise tiles as a data-URI SVG background-image — no external request

acceptance.zh: 噪点层 aria-hidden,移除后页面信息完整
acceptance.en: The noise layer is aria-hidden; removing it loses no information
